treated_half_escalation: 3 or more disagreements in the treated half of 15 are escalated immediately; blocking remains >= 4 of 30
split_draw_note: Only the control half was drawn: the other side's lookup had not landed at draw time. Rulebook §10 expects a single 30-draw; this split is a documented deviation, recorded here and in the dated note under research/empirics_v4/. The remaining cells are drawn with the same seed once their lookup lands, and no cell is dropped.
disagreement_rule: disagreement > 10% (>= 4 of 30) blocks the leg (rulebook §10, SPEC §8.3/§8.9)
blindness: bid12_audit_pairs.csv is the auditor's only input besides the rulebook; bid12_audit_key.csv is revealed after the auditor's readings are recorded
